# Pull Request Template

## What does this pull request do?

<!-- One or two sentences. -->

## Type of change

- [ ] Add a resource
- [ ] Add or edit an RSS/Atom feed
- [ ] Fix a broken or outdated link
- [ ] Improve documentation
- [ ] Change tooling or automation
- [ ] Other (describe below)

## Checklist

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` and `dev/README.md`.
- [ ] The resource is open source, open access, free, or freemium.
- [ ] The entry uses the standard format and has at least one label.
- [ ] `make validate` passes.
- [ ] `make all` and, if relevant, `make links` were run.
- [ ] Generated files (`dev/resources.json`, `dev/feeds.opml`) are up to date.
- [ ] No duplicate URLs were introduced.
